# Psalm 27 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-David. YHWH [is] my-light and-my-salvation — whom shall-I-fear? YHWH [is] the-stronghold of-my-life — of-whom shall-I-be-afraid?

**2** When-the-evildoers draw-near against-me to-eat my-flesh — my-adversaries and-my-enemies to-me — they stumble and-fall.

**3** If a-camp encamps against-me, my-heart shall-not fear; if war rises against-me, in-this I-trust.

**4** One [thing] I-have-asked of-YHWH, this I-seek: to-dwell in-the-house of-YHWH all the-days of-my-life, to-behold the-beauty of-YHWH and-to-inquire in-His-temple.

**5** For He-hides-me in-His-shelter in-the-day of-trouble; He-conceals-me in-the-hiding-place of-His-tent; on-a-rock He-sets-me-high.

**6** And-now my-head is-lifted-up above my-enemies around-me, and-I-sacrifice in-His-tent sacrifices-of shouting; I-sing and-make-music to-YHWH.

**7** Hear, YHWH, my-voice [when] I-call; and-be-gracious to-me and-answer-me.

**8** To-You my-heart says, "Seek My-face." Your-face, YHWH, I-seek.

**9** Do-not hide Your-face from-me; do-not turn-away in-anger Your-servant. My-help You-have-been; do-not cast-me-off and-do-not forsake-me, O-God of-my-salvation.

**10** For my-father and-my-mother have-forsaken-me, but-YHWH gathers-me-in.

**11** Teach-me Your-way, YHWH, and-lead-me on-a-level path because-of my-enemies.

**12** Do-not give-me to-the-desire of-my-adversaries, for false witnesses have-risen against-me, and-one-breathing-out violence.

**13** [I would have despaired] unless I-had-believed to-see the-goodness of-YHWH in-the-land of-the-living.

**14** Wait for-YHWH; be-strong and-let-your-heart take-courage; and-wait for-YHWH.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **27:4**: The 'one thing' — singular focus amid plural threats. The psalmist's deepest desire is not rescue but presence.

— EMET
